---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] Brief description of the feature"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Include:
- API changes
- UI/UX changes
- Configuration options
- Integration points

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Additional Context
- Related issues or discussions
- Mockups or examples
- Links to similar implementations

## Implementation Notes
Any technical details or considerations for implementing this feature:
- Dependencies that might need to be added
- Breaking changes
- Performance implications
- Security considerations

## Checklist
- [ ] This feature request is not a duplicate
- [ ] The feature aligns with the project's goals
- [ ] I've provided sufficient detail for implementation
